confidence_notes: Second simulator entry for a car curated from AMS2. Clutch-free move-off, six gears, clutchless upshifts and downshifts, and an automatic blip were directly observed. The rim was inspected in the cockpit and carries no display and no shift lights, which settles a field the AMS2 observation left unknown. The automatic cut is not established and cannot be by this method: Assetto Corsa EVO publishes no engine torque to SimHub, and the cut is ignition-side so the throttle channel cannot show it either. AMS2 established the cut independently and that value is unchanged.
scope_notes: Single exact identity staged from one guided-verification drive.
